correctness.rationale: Under Haar-initial cat dynamics at epsilon=0, the exact eigenprojection reduction turns a signed character relation into two reciprocal exponential-sum identities. Single-side counts 1/k are excluded by Cauchy–Schwarz; 2/2 equalities cancel; at degree five the Lucas identity \(L_h-1=L_p+L_q+L_{p+q}\) has the single nontrivial solution \(h=2,p=q=0\). This proves all-time minimality. Integration gives \(\sin\alpha/16\), count of 20 orderings gives \(5\max(N-2,0)\sin\alpha/4\); lower moments and cumulants follow. Verified exact checker (17 sites, 10 horizons) supports but does not replace proof.

value.rationale: The fifth moment is the first genuinely allowable arithmetic resonance (lower degrees provably independent-like), a motivated minimal-dependence invariant rather than an arbitrary moment. Its exact \(O(N)\) coefficient and phase dependence expose higher-order diffusion invisible to covariance, with a reproducible analytic and exact-integer benchmark for a published cat-driven circle model. It is restricted to \(\varepsilon=0\) and does not claim a CLT or higher-order moments.
